notes.title: Ver1.03
notes.content: Fixed enemy behavior so that they do not suddenly turn back.

notes.title: Ver1.02
notes.content: Fixed so that when hiding in a closet while being chased by an enemy, if the enemy is within a certain distance, the closet will open even if the enemy cannot see the player.

notes.title: Ver1.01
notes.content: Changed specifications to prevent the monster from opening the closet during the search. (If they see you hiding in the closet while being chased, they will open the closet)
